samaveda_hymn1.introduction: The opening section of the Purvarchika contains hymns dedicated to Agni, the fire deity, set to melodic patterns for ritual chanting.
samaveda_hymn1.scripture_text: A representative Samavedic hymn passage for Hymn 1, expressing melodic devotion, sacred recitation, and meditative harmony.
samaveda_hymn1.philosophical_explanation: Agni represents both the external sacrificial fire and the inner spiritual flame of consciousness. The musical praise of Agni symbolizes the awakening of spiritual awareness through devoted practice.
